title: Paddington, the bear from Peru.
lines: Far away, in the dark jungle of Peru, lives a little bear.
He lives with Aunt Lucy and Uncle Pastuzo.
They make it themselves, from the oranges on the trees.
One day the little bear travels to London.
A big city, far across the sea.
He travels on a boat, hidden among the boxes.
He wears a blue coat and a red hat.
And under his hat he always keeps a marmalade sandwich.
There's a label on his coat.
It says: Please look after this bear.
The bear sits on a suitcase in the big railway station.
Lots and lots of people walk past.
A daddy, a mummy and two children.
The bear says his name in bear language.
You know what, we'll call you Paddington.
Paddington goes home with the Browns.
In the bathroom he wants to have a bath.
He doesn't know how the tap works.
Paddington floats down the hall in the bathtub.
But the children think Paddington is wonderful.
He always says thank you and please.
One day Paddington sees a thief.
The thief steals a wallet from an old gentleman.
He gives him his hard stare.
He learned that stare from Aunt Lucy.
The thief gets such a fright that he drops the wallet.
That evening they sit at the table together.
Paddington writes a letter to Aunt Lucy.
He puts down the letter and takes a bite of his marmalade sandwich.
